about: Hand decisions about MT2 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mt2.md, Stat blocks; decision 7); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, and the start of the entry's header
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why

text      match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

A number inside its rank's range but not its standard (the Hobart Gang's, printed 28-29) needs no override: the registry's rank_ranges (scripts/msh/books.json, the mt2 entry) has the check take the range for this book alone (survey decision 8).

overrides.note: Printed A GD 6 and S GD 6 (printed 6, column 2): 6 is Typical's number, outside Good's range (8-15), and Health 52 = 20 + 6 + 6 + 20 holds on the 6s, so the codes are the misprint. Survey decision 7.

Printed Karma: 10 (printed 33, column 2, a one-line grid with no name line): R + I + P = 4 + 6 + 4 = 14, and every number agrees with its code, so the total is the misprint; Health 50 = 10 + 10 + 10 + 20 holds. Survey decision 7.
Printed 5, the Scarlet Witch's Hex Spheres: the capital I opening the quoted example is read as a vertical bar. Both double quotes of the row are right (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 7).
Printed 8, the Black Knight's Flying Horse: the horse's ability letters print I between R and P, read as a vertical bar (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 10).
Printed 53, Ghost Rider IV's notes: the page prints the roman numeral I, read as a vertical bar (seen on a 300 dpi crop of PDF 55).
